mapper.select: SELECT execution_facts.task_id AS taskId, execution_facts.total_group_count AS totalGroupCount, execution_facts.completed_group_count AS completedGroupCount, execution_facts.failed_group_count AS failedGroupCount, execution_facts.abandoned_group_count AS abandonedGroupCount, execution_facts.executing_group_count AS executingGroupCount, execution_facts.waiting_group_count AS waitingGroupCount, execution_facts.manager_shortage_group_count AS managerShortageGroupCount, execution_facts.puller_shortage_group_count AS pullerShortageGroupCount, execution_facts.station_shortage_group_count AS stationShortageGroupCount, COALESCE(material_facts.total_member_count, 0) AS totalMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.unconsumed_member_count, 0) AS unconsumedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.submitted_member_count, 0) AS submittedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.successful_member_count, 0) AS successfulMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.failed_member_count, 0) AS failedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.unknown_member_count, 0) AS unknownMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.canceled_member_count, 0) AS canceledMemberCount, COALESCE(account_facts.available_puller_count, 0) AS availablePullerCount, execution_facts.last_executed_at AS lastExecutedAt FROM ( SELECT execution_row.task_id, COUNT(*) AS total_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.completed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.failed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.abandoned} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.executing} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS executing_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status IN (#{criteria.execution.waitStart}, #{criteria.execution.waitResource}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.waitResource} AND execution_row.wait_resource_type = #{criteria.execution.managerResource} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manager_shortage_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.waitResource} AND execution_row.wait_resource_type = #{criteria.execution.pullerResource} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS puller_shortage_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.waitResource} AND execution_row.wait_resource_type = #{criteria.execution.stationResource} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS station_shortage_group_count, MAX(execution_row.last_business_executed_at) AS last_executed_at FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row WHERE execution_row.task_id IN GROUP BY execution_row.task_id ) execution_facts LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_execution.task_id, COUNT(*) AS total_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unconsumed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconsumed_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.submitted} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submitted_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.success} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.failed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unknown} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.canceled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_member_count FROM pull_task_material_member material_row JOIN pull_task_group_execution material_execution ON material_execution.id = material_row.group_execution_id AND material_execution.tenant_id = material_row.tenant_id WHERE material_execution.task_id IN GROUP BY material_execution.task_id ) material_facts ON material_facts.task_id = execution_facts.task_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_row.task_id, COUNT(*) AS available_puller_count FROM pull_task_group_account account_row WHERE account_row.task_id IN AND account_row.role_type = #{criteria.account.pullerRole} AND account_row.availability_status = #{criteria.account.available} AND account_row.released_at IS NULL GROUP BY account_row.task_id ) account_facts ON account_facts.task_id = execution_facts.task_id ORDER BY execution_facts.task_id DESC
